content.title: About
content.content: Flavored Martini is a ready‑to‑drink alcoholic beverage based on gin and vermouth, enhanced with natural flavorings such as berries, citrus or herbs. It has a characteristic dry taste with a hint of sweetness and aromatic aftertaste, suitable for sipping neat or using in cocktails.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first flavored Martini appeared in the 1970s as a response to growing demand for lighter, aromatic drinks.
There are more than 20 flavor variants: lemon, raspberry, strawberry, cucumber, rosemary, etc.
Martini is a key ingredient in classic cocktails like the Martini Julep, Vodka Martini and Martini with tonic.
The "Martini" brand was registered in Italy in 1863 and has become synonymous with premium vermouth.
Flavored versions often contain less sugar than the traditional sweet vermouth.

items.title: Moderate consumption may promote relaxation
items.content: Small amounts of alcohol have a calming effect, reducing stress and improving mood.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Natural flavorings (berries, citrus) are rich in polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: May support cardiovascular health when consumed moderately
items.content: Studies suggest moderate vermouth intake can improve blood lipid profiles.

items.title: Alcohol‑related risk
items.content: Excessive intake leads to intoxication, impaired coordination and long‑term health issues.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Alcohol can amplify the effects of sedatives, anticoagulants and certain antibiotics.

items.title: Not recommended for pregnant or nursing women
items.content: Alcohol may adversely affect fetal development and lactation.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Some flavored versions contain added sugar, which is important for people with diabetes.

content.title: How to Drink
content.content: Serve flavored Martini chilled in a martini glass or use it as a cocktail base. Add ice, an olive, lemon zest or fresh berries to enhance the flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the bottle in a cool, dark place with the cap tightly sealed. After opening, it is best consumed within 3–6 months to preserve aroma and taste.
